text.tspan: Family note: presence over presents, and also
sometimes presents help.
Cousins I barely knew became familiar after
one long weekend.
Writing it down so I do not forget.
Forgiveness is a practice with follow-through.
We revisited a childhood place and it felt
smaller and sweeter.
Name the person who always organizes and
relieve them sometimes.
I am practicing saying no to plans without
writing an essay.
Logistics are a love language in extended
families.

one long weekend.
Ordinary updates keep relationships warm.
I mailed a handwritten note because texts
disappear.

relieve them sometimes.
Old stories get funnier when the people in
them are safe now.
